title: Practical Prayers
claim: Eight moments of the day plus one clockless Anytime — nine sections, four prayers each, thirty-six pocket prayers that face their explanation. This is the book for the clock: verses to be said at the sink, at the desk, in the queue, in the dark, and mantras in the Anytime pocket that belong to no hour because they belong to every one. Nothing here needs belief; the verses were built to be said, and each one tells you when, how, and how to know it is working. Emotional weather — fear, grief, flatness, elation — is deliberately out of scope: that is Tantric Prayer's territory, where the nine rasas give every feeling its Sanskrit name and its verse.

sections_plan.purpose: short portable mantras — no clock needed, carry them all day
on rising — the first words before the feet touch the floor
water and body — the body as temple, washing as offering
out among people — speech, encounter, the world talking back
at the desk — labour as worship, focus, offering the task
before eating — the mealtime yajña, the offering made of everything
in the in-between — queues, pauses, the gaps the day hands you
illness and pain — the body failing, refuge when strength is gone
wind down and lights out — the day's weight set down at the door

inclusion: a prayer belongs here only if a moment of the day (or the clockless Anytime pocket) names when to say it
each entry carries source_path + source_ref to a file in this book's sources/ and four explainer blocks (what/how/sign, feel optional)
Anytime holds only short mantras recitable in seconds — pocket length is the admission test
verses come from our own corpus (Śivastotrāvalī, Abhinavagupta/Kṣemarāja stotras, Gītā meal verse, Swamiji's recitation list); translations are ours
every entry faces its explanation: brief (C1 essence), what (sense), how (the text's own practice), sign (the text's own claimed effect) — feel optional
content is extract-and-place from named sources and layers; clarity-edits only after placing; no source = block stays off the page (fail closed)
whole book must preflight under the template page ceiling with the template style before the build stage opens
exclusion: mood-state sections (positive, negative, alone, flatness, gratitude) — emotional states belong to Tantric Prayer's rasa ladder, not to a clock book
no entry may also appear in Tantric Prayer — one prayer, one book, never both
no dhyana mantras in pocket sections — long meditation verses are not recitable in a queue (owner ruling 2026-11-06: the three Bahurūpa dhyāna mantras retire)
Lakshmanjoo/Dyczkowski prose is never printed beyond brief attributed quotation in front matter; all guide prose is extract-and-place from our layers
no entry may appear in another book — one prayer, one book (cross-book id and IAST uniqueness is gate-enforced)
no agent-written prose anywhere in the entry fields; translations are ours, Lakshmanjoo/Dyczkowski prose is never printed beyond brief attributed quotation
no PDF build before content, structure, and formatting are confirmed — the build stage is the LAST stage of the pipeline, never the first
